_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, margin, expense and receivables signals with Google's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Alphabet is a collection of businesses -- the largest of which, of course, is Google.' 'We generate substantially all of our revenues from advertising, and reduced spending by advertisers or a loss of partners could harm our business.' 'We face intense competition.' 'As our growth rate has slowed, the cyclicality and seasonality in our business has become more pronounced and caused our operating results to fluctuate.' 'In addition, expenditures by advertisers tend to be cyclical, reflecting overall economic conditions and budgeting and buying patterns.' (FY2016 10-K); CYCLICAL: the 10-K says so of its own business ('the cyclicality and seasonality in our business'), the BKR, CAT and NVDA reading, not an industry's words; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a search and advertising company on these dates (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services; CLOUD, live from 2012-10-30, is scoped to public cloud displacing on-premise IT, and this 10-K names the cloud as Google's own products and its competitors in them ('Providers of enterprise cloud services, including Amazon and Microsoft.'), so it is out of scope (the AVGO FY2012 and NVDA reading); ECOMMERCE (from 2015-01-01), STREAMING (from 2015-08-04) and ENERGY_TRANSITION (from 2015-12-12) are scoped to physical retail, linear TV and pay-TV bundles, and fossil fuels), so the watch list is empty; the competition named is a competitive field, not a theme, and stays here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +22.6%/yr (Q3 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +22.6%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +40.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: GOOG (retrospective, 2017-11-24) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.48x (52.4% downside to Bear $495.73 / +15.0% upside to Bull $1197.20) | Adj composite 1.76 vs market 3.17: gap -1.41 [OVERVALUED] | +97% above the EPP floor $529.15 (19x FY17E $27.85) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.5% total (-5.2%/yr) | At 37.4x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $1,376.21 sits above the BULL case; revenue +23.7% YoY in Q3 2017, forward revenues +23.7% (Q3 2017 revenue growth (no Q4 2017 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
